name: Soybean (ZS) Forward Curve & Term Structure
description: Soybean futures forward curve analysis. Uses NoAdjustment continuation with spread_depth=1. Calculates front spread (M1-M2), carry % (M1/M2-1), annualized carry (365/52 factor for 7 contract months/year), and contango frequency (rolling 60d and full-period). Outputs: summary table, front spread line chart, rolling contango frequency line chart.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SOYBEAN (ZS) FORWARD CURVE & TERM STRUCTURE
# =============================================================================
#
# Direct mirror of the ZC forward curve study, adapted for soybeans.
#
# NoAdjustment preserves real price levels for spread/carry analysis.
# ZS has 7 contract months/year (Jan, Mar, May, Jul, Aug, Sep, Nov),
# so average inter-contract spacing ≈ 52 days → annualize with 365/52.
#
# Outputs:
#   1. Summary table: front spread, annualized carry, contango frequencies
#   2. Front spread (M1 - M2) line chart
#   3. Rolling 60-day contango frequency line chart
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: ZS (Soybeans) with NoAdjustment + term structure ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Key series ---
front_spread = cont.spread      # M1 - M2 in cents/bu
carry_pct = cont.carry           # M1/M2 - 1 (positive = backwardation, negative = contango)

# --- Contango flag ---
is_contango = carry_pct < 0

# --- Annualized carry ---
# ZS: 7 contract months/year → avg spacing ~52 days → multiply by 365/52
ann_carry = carry_pct * (365.0 / 52.0)

# --- Rolling 60-day contango frequency ---
# Boolean auto-casts to 0/1; ma gives proportion of days in contango
contango_freq_60d = ma(period=60)(is_contango)

# --- Full-period contango frequency (expanding mean) ---
contango_freq_full = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(is_contango)

ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZS Forward Curve Snapshot',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current Values', 'Contango Frequency'],
        col_headers=['Spread / Full Period', 'Carry / Rolling 60d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Front Spread (M1-M2, cents/bu)', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Annualized Carry (%)', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(info='Full-Period Contango Frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(info='Rolling 60d Contango Frequency', grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(front_spread, ann_carry, contango_freq_full, contango_freq_60d)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Front Spread (M1 - M2) Over Time
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='ZS Front Spread (M1 - M2)',
    category='2. Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='Spread (cents/bu)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M1 - M2 Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(front_spread,))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Rolling 60-Day Contango Frequency
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Contango Frequency',
    category='2. Term Structure',
    y_axis_label='% Days in Contango',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50%')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Contango Freq', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(contango_freq_60d,))
